pr_title: Better names and types for ingest stats
pr_body:
Closes #80763

Follow up to #93483

Adds a specialized internal `OnFailureProcessor` wrapper that formalizes `on_failure` and `ignore_failure` handling, and then adds unwrapping of that class when we calculate stats (similar to how `ConditionalProcessor` is already unwrapped). The result is greatly improved clarity and consistency for the names and types that we report for ingest stats.
pr_comments: Hi @joegallo, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: nodes/stats for ingest pipeline name and type may be misleading

review_comments: I don't think we have any test coverage (in OnFailureProcessorTests or IngestStatsNamesAndTypesIT) for when `onFailureProcessors` is not empty, do we? Might also be worth documenting that that is non-empty if there is an `on_failure` block, and empty if `ignore_failure` = true.
I pulled this out into its own PR, see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/93573.
